channel.title: TimTime
channel.description: Updates for TimTime — a minimalist macOS menu bar time tracker.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
TimTime 1.1.0

  • New — Colors. Give your labels colors and group your time into categories. Shift-click one or more labels and pick a color; name your colors (e.g. "Personal", "Business").
  • New — By color. The week and month views show how your time splits across your color categories, with percentages.
  • New — Month view. A compact day-by-day timeline for the whole month.
  • Timelines and breakdowns are color-coded — hover a label to spotlight its time and dim the rest.
  • Merge several labels at once by shift-selecting them.
  • The menu now caps at 80% of your screen height and scrolls, so long label lists stay usable.

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
TimTime 1.0.5

  • Fixed a crash that could quit the app when the check-in prompt or menu changed size (notably on macOS 26 Tahoe).
  • The "Take a break" button now looks the same everywhere — quiet by default, and grows into the full reminder once you're overdue, whether you open it from the menu or a check-in.

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
TimTime 1.0.4

  • Fixed a crash that could still quit the app during check-in prompts — 1.0.3 addressed only part of the cause; this resolves the rest.

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
TimTime 1.0.3

  • Fixed a crash that could quit the app unexpectedly during check-in prompts.
  • Stand-up reminders now repeat every 15 minutes once you're overdue for a break, instead of nudging just once.
  • The break prompt is now part of the same check-in — one interface, with a big "time since last break" and varied encouragement to step away.
  • New: a "Take a break" button pinned at the bottom of the menu, always in the same place.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
TimTime 1.0.2

  • Fixed: no longer quietly switches itself to a break when a check-in goes unanswered.
  • A break that started on its own (e.g. after your Mac sleeps) now ends and asks what you're working on as soon as you're back at the keyboard.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
TimTime 1.0.1

  • New: About TimTime panel and a "Last checked" update line.
  • Refined break prompt — one tap to take a break or keep your current task.
  • Fixes the in-app update check (feed URL).

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
TimTime 1.0.0

  • First public release — minimalist menu bar time tracking.
  • Switch-to-start labels, daily/weekly breakdown, gentle work/break nudges.
